CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Commissioner Jeff Boozell, Commissioner Hunter Chang, Commissioner Elizabeth Feffer, Vice
Chair Charles Martinson, Chair Al Boegh

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Public Safety
Commission by submitting a public comment request and giving it to the Fire
Department prior to the meeting. At this time, the public may address the Public
Safety Commission on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to state law, the Planning
Commission may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda
(Government Code Section 54954.3). The Chair reserves the right to place limits on duration
of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items

  DEPARTMENT REPORTS

1.  POLICE DEPARTMENT REPORT
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Public Safety Commission receive and
  file the Police Department report.

2.  FIRE DEPARTMENT REPORT
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Public Safety Commission receive and
  file the Fire Department report.

3.  PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT REPORT
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Public Safety Commission receive and
  file the Public Works Department report.

All public writings distributed by the City of San Marino to at least a majority of the Public
